We analyze the on-device LLM features currently released on mobile phones by major manufacturers, dividing them into 5 major categories with 20 tasks. Based on this, we propose SmartBench, the first (Chinese) benchmark for assessing the capabilities of on-device LLMs in mobile scenarios.
outputs: Generated summaries, polished text, Q&A responses, etc.

Summaries of documents, calls, recordings, meetings; answers to text Q&A (document, retrieval, personal); refined or generated text for content creation tasks (polishing, continuation, abbreviation, expansion, creation, formatting, instant reply, correction); extracted entities/relations/events; notification sorting and message summarization results.
The paper evaluates generated outputs such as summaries, answers, created text, extracted information, and notification summaries in mobile scenarios.
